interpretation_limits: This MassBank experiment is distinct from the Vaniya-Fiehn LTQ/QTOF benchmark.
Frozen query/library manifests, processing/scoring thresholds, selection, and denominators were unchanged; retrieval diagnostics are non-scoring.
Truth attribution uses full InChIKey and is benchmark-only; truth labels are not passed into production annotation.
Present and mixed absent-truth rates remain cohort-specific descriptive results.
Empty/one-decoy confidence states do not establish calibrated FDR.
